description.zh: 点播加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名。
description.en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD. You can query only one domain name.

description.zh: 功能名称。一次可查询多个功能配置信息，多个功能名称之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。点播加速域名支持配置的功能及各功能名称，请参见[域名配置功能函数](~~2411639~~)。
description.en: The name of the feature. You can query the configurations of multiple features at a time. Separate multiple feature names with commas (,). For features that can be configured for accelerated domain names for ApsaraVideo VOD and the names of the features, see [Functions for domain name configurations](~~2411639~~).

descriptions.zh: - 目前服务地址仅支持：**华东2（上海）**。
